# chdman

`chdman.exe` is from the official [MAME 0.289 Windows x64 release](https://github.com/mamedev/mame/releases/tag/mame0289). VR4ALL uses it only to extract a user's own Wipeout CHD into temporary files before packaging the game's data for the Quest. The temporary disc image is removed after the install job.

MAMEdev and contributors retain copyright to chdman. The official [MAME source](https://github.com/mamedev/mame/tree/mame0289) and the included `COPYING` and `GPL-2.0` files provide its corresponding source and license terms. VR4ALL does not include game data.
